answer_1.quote: simultaneous translation ... aims at a real-time translation that demands high translation quality and an as-short-as-possible delay between speech and translation output.

answer_2.quote: we use BLEU score to evaluate translation quality, and Average Lagging to measure latency.

answer_4.quote: We further ask human translators to evaluate the quality of MU and MU++. They rated each translation in Bad, OK and Good based on the translations' adequacy, correctness and fluency
answer_4.guideline: Human translators rated translations as Bad, OK, or Good based on adequacy, correctness, and fluency.
